synthesis: Part 1 reshapes StagingLiveHitLeader off a filter-independent 13-month top-10 onto the Unique Scans rollup: every date arm, including this_month, uses one window; GROUP BY kit_id WITH ROLLUP; key 0 is the org total; StagingLiveHits reads that key so the card headline and the ranking are one cached scan. Part 1b converts those window bounds viewer-local → UTC with ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery::toUtcDatetimeFor before interpolation, and uses safeTimezone() (UTC, no throw) for the month arms. The shared cache-helper work already replaced dashboardCacheTTL() with ResolvesDashboardCacheTtl::baseDashboardCacheTTL. AC5's remaining hand-roll is LEADER_CACHE_PREFIX / leaderCacheKey: replace the ranking cache with a class-neutral rememberedRange on StagingLiveHitLeaderQuery that calls baseDashboardCacheTTL(0). Do not call the scan-plate-stats keys. Part 2 writes an audit of RecoveryLeaderQuery against okf/concepts/lpr-assist.md and coordinates the view-without-FINAL gap to that Cloud measure without closing or implementing that bug. AC7: accept viewer-local Y-m-d against repo_date (it is a Date); replace addslashes with a Y-m-d assert; stop RecoveryLeader from using ClickhouseQuery::query() so a failure is not cached as an empty board.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC1 The Staging Live Hit Leaderboard responds to the selected date filter for every arm, including this_month, with no fixed 13-month spread.
acceptance_criteria.reason: this_month still returns getMonthlyLeaderData()'s last bucket (StagingLiveHitLeader.php:330-332). The ranked list becomes one window on every arm. The 13-point sparkline of org totals stays; that is the Unique Scans shape, not the spread AC1 removes.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC2 One ClickHouse scan serves both the Staging Live Hit card and its leaderboard (rollup key 0 = org total).
acceptance_criteria.reason: Ranking is StagingLiveHitLeaderQuery with no rollup. The card headline is HitPlateStatsBatchQuery through SharedHitStatsData. Both will read StagingLiveHitLeaderQuery::rememberedRange. Key 0 is the only org total. All four date arms share, including last_month.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC3 Staging Live Hit windows are converted viewer-local → UTC before interpolation; invalid users.dti falls back to UTC without throwing.
acceptance_criteria.reason: Copy safeTimezone (L164-169, no throw) and toUtcDatetimeFor (L640-643). Month arms use currentMonthWindow / lastMonthWindow. today / last_7d keep the raw viewer zone, matching UniqueScansLeaderboard::resolveRangeAndTimezone.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC4 uniqExactIf(ocr, …), kit_org_id scoping, and kit_id keying are preserved; verified by test.
acceptance_criteria.reason: Already the query contract and pinned by StagingLiveHitLeaderQueryTest. hits_cold ORDER BY leads with hotlist_org_id, so kit_org_id is a correctness choice. FINAL does not collapse duplicate ids when hit_created_at changed.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC5 The hand-rolled leaderboard cache is replaced by the shared cache helpers, TTL ladder and impersonation collapse intact.
acceptance_criteria.reason: Helpers exist on d8e70005. Trait is already used. Remaining work is the class-neutral range key and rememberedRange calling baseDashboardCacheTTL(0). Impersonation is 10 seconds inside that method. Do not invent a second ladder.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC6 recovery_scans audit produces a written finding: either accurate as-is with the measurement, or a defect list with a follow-up ticket per defect.
acceptance_criteria.reason: Written finding only. Measurement is read-only aggregates on the provisioned fleet Docker ClickHouse. A pgsql mirror is not the done-signal. Cloud ClickHouse is read-only and this plan does not query it for writes. The view-without-FINAL Cloud measure stays the owner of that gap.

acceptance_criteria.item: AC7 The RecoveryLeaderQuery timezone gap and Throwable-swallow behaviour are each explicitly resolved or recorded as accepted, with the reason.
acceptance_criteria.reason: Plan decides both. Timezone: accept viewer-local Y-m-d vs repo_date Date; replace addslashes with a Y-m-d assert. Swallow: resolve on RecoveryLeader only by leaving ClickhouseQuery::query(). Do not change ClickhouseQuery.
